name: Foldable Magnetic Car Phone Holder | 360° Rotating Suction Mount, Universal
description:
The Foldable Magnetic Car Phone Holder offers hands-free convenience and safe driving. With a 360° rotating suction cup mount, it allows flexible positioning on your dashboard, windshield, desk, or wall. The strong magnetic grip keeps your phone secure, even on bumpy roads, while the compact, foldable design ensures portability and easy storage. Compatible with all smartphones, it is an essential accessory for every driver.
Key Features
 Foldable design for portability and easy storage
 360° rotation for flexible viewing angles
 Strong vacuum suction with magnetic fastening for secure hold
 Universal compatibility with all smartphone models
 Sleek black finish to match any car interior
How to Use
 Clean the surface before mounting
 Attach suction cup to desired location
 Place phone on magnetic holder and adjust angle
 Fold and store when not in use
Material
ABS plastic, strong magnetic components, vacuum suction cup
Safety Information
 Avoid attaching to uneven or damaged surfaces
 Keep away from children
 Do not place in areas exposed to extreme heat
 Ensure secure attachment before driving
Package Includes
 1 × Foldable Magnetic Car Phone Holder
